text: 国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，多渠道促进居民增收。健全按要素分配政策制度，促进多劳者多得、技高者多得、创新者多得。完善劳动者工资决定、合理增长、支付保障机制，健全最低工资标准调整机制，稳步提高最低工资标准，加强企业工资分配宏观指导。持续改善小微企业和个体工商户经营环境。促进房地产市场持续健康发展，持续巩固资本市场稳中向好发展态势，多渠道增加城乡居民财产性收入。加强税收、社会保障、转移支付等再分配调节。
text_en: The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' promoting multi-channel income growth for residents. It will improve factor-based distribution policies, ensuring more pay for more work, higher skills, and greater innovation. Mechanisms for wage determination, reasonable growth, and payment security will be refined, with adjustments to minimum wage standards and macro guidance on corporate wage distribution. The business environment for small and micro enterprises and self-employed individuals will be continuously improved. The healthy and stable development of the real estate market will be promoted, the stable and positive trend of the capital market will be consolidated, and urban and rural residents' property income will be increased through multiple channels. Redistributive adjustments via taxation, social security, and transfer payments will be strengthened.
